# Week <% tp.date.now("YYYY-[W]WW") %> Review

## Tickets This Week

```dataview
TABLE ticket, date
FROM "YOUR_VAULT_NAME/20-tickets"
WHERE date >= date(today) - dur(7 days)
SORT date DESC
```

<!-- Replace YOUR_VAULT_NAME with your Obsidian vault name (set in config.json → vault_name) -->

## Learning Gaps This Week

```dataview
LIST
FROM "YOUR_VAULT_NAME/10-concepts"
WHERE econtains(file.etags, "#learning-gap")
SORT file.mtime DESC
LIMIT 10
```

## Resources in Queue

```dataview
LIST
FROM "YOUR_VAULT_NAME/40-resources"
WHERE econtains(file.etags, "#to-read")
SORT file.mtime ASC
LIMIT 5
```
